press.title: A second wave of migration in western Tamil Nadu
press.summary: TNBS members reported seasonal post-monsoon movements of Blue Tigers, Dark Blue Tigers, and two crow butterfly species across five western districts including Salem, Namakkal, Erode, Tiruppur, and Coimbatore.

press.title: A Painted Lady sighting in Sivaganga
press.summary: A local naturalist documented a Painted Lady near Sivaganga, and TNBS member Ramanasaran Hari discussed seasonal migratory dispersal factors behind the interior plains record.

press.title: Coimbatore records 1,820 taxa in City Nature Challenge
press.summary: TNBS joined local conservation organizations and citizen scientists across Coimbatore to document plants, butterflies, birds, and insects during the global urban biodiversity challenge.

press.title: A Sinhalese Five-ring recorded near Madurai
press.summary: Madurai Nature and Cultural Forum recorded the butterfly along the Sathuragiri trail, with a TNBS member sharing diagnostic sighting details.

press.title: Coimbatore Forest Division biodiversity survey
press.summary: An annual collaborative field census uniting the Coimbatore Forest Division, Coimbatore Nature Society, TNBS, and WWF-India.

press.title: Danainae Butterfly Migration over Tamil Nadu: 2024 Update
press.summary: A. Pavendhan details pre-monsoon (April-May, 25-30/min) and post-monsoon (late September, up to 200/min across Yercaud, Salem, Tiruppur, and Coimbatore) flights of Tigers and Crows.

press.title: Notes on Common Palmfly & Cloud Forest Silverline in Tamil Nadu
press.summary: Documents validated Chennai, Puducherry, and Sirumalai records of Common Palmfly (Elymnias hypermnestra) and Meghamalai records of Cloud Forest Silverline (Cigaritis meghamalaiensis).

press.title: Picture Stories: Banded Royal & Golden Angle early stages
press.summary: Kumaresan Chandrabose, Ramanasaran Hari, and A. Pavendhan feature mistletoe-dependent Banded Royals from Pachamalai and Urena lobata caterpillars of Golden Angle.

press.title: Higher count of butterfly species recorded in Pachamalai during Forest Department study
press.summary: A two-day December survey by Tiruchirappalli Forest Division and TNBS documented 126 butterfly species across all six families, including the Schedule II Banded Royal, bringing Pachamalai's combined checklist to 149.

press.title: Survey finds 126 butterfly species on Pachamalai hills
press.summary: Joint assessment across seven reserve forests in Thuraiyur range revealed thriving populations of Common Albatross, Small Grass Yellow, Double-banded Judy, Rustic, and the rare Banded Royal.

press.title: Spectacular butterfly migration thrives in Coimbatore after rainfall boost
press.summary: Strong August rainfall over the Eastern Ghats triggered a full-scale southwest flight across Salem, Tiruppur, and Coimbatore toward the Nilgiris and Anamalais.

press.title: Seasonal butterfly migration to the Western Ghats observed
press.summary: TNBS documented dense directional flights of Dark Blue Tigers, Blue Tigers, Common Crows, and Double-branded Crows moving at up to 200 individuals per minute over Coimbatore skies.

press.title: Butterfly park opened near Vellalore in Coimbatore
press.summary: Built near the Vellalore lake and Miyawaki forest by KKPA following a year-long TNBS butterfly assessment that documented 101 local butterfly species.

press.title: Common Grass Yellows on the move in Mudumalai
press.summary: Forest staff, naturalists, and TNBS volunteers observed a rare mass migration of thousands of Common Grass Yellows during the three-day June monsoon survey in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve.

press.title: Monsoon butterfly survey in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve records 185 species
press.summary: Sixteen teams across all eight ranges of Mudumalai Tiger Reserve documented 185 species across six families, lifting the reserve's cumulative checklist to 217 species.

press.title: Tracking the pre-monsoon migration across western Tamil Nadu
press.summary: TNBS reported active April and May butterfly flights moving southwest-to-northeast from Pollachi and Coimbatore toward Tiruppur, Erode, and Sathyamangalam.

press.title: Butterfly observers from Tamil Nadu correlate healthy migration with good rain
press.summary: TNBS president A. Pavendhan and observers connected healthier 2024 pre-monsoon tiger and crow numbers to timely regional rainfall and breeding habitat recovery.

press.title: Butterfly Park a haven for winged visitors and nature lovers in Coimbatore
press.summary: A dedicated book authored by TNBS president A. Pavendhan catalogued 101 butterfly species recorded across a year-long study around Vellalore Tank.

press.title: Parambikulam Tiger Reserve faunal survey adds 4 butterfly records
press.summary: Six TNBS members joined TNHS, Kerala Forest Department, and partner groups in a three-day Parambikulam faunal assessment adding 11 new species records including 4 butterflies.

press.title: Butterfly Migration Report 2023 & Albatross Movement in Coimbatore
press.summary: A. Pavendhan tracks how 2023 Salem and Namakkal rainfall deficits dampened Danainae numbers while Common Albatross surged from Kallar toward Sirumugai and Sathyamangalam.

press.title: Kanyakumari Wildlife Sanctuary survey & Common Ciliate Blue record
press.summary: Dr. Amol Mande recounts the May 2023 KWLS survey around Kizhviyar and Mothiramalai highlighting Southern Duffer, Orange-tailed Awl, and a first TN photo record of Common Ciliate Blue.

press.title: Life Cycle of the Southern Birdwing & Erode Wetland Documentations
press.summary: Ramanasaran Hari illustrates Southern Birdwing egg-to-adult metamorphosis alongside K. Sadheeskumar documenting 26-28 species at Elathur, Odathurai, and Nagamalai in Erode district.

press.title: Coimbatore city's first butterfly park getting ready at Vellalore tank
press.summary: Nectar and larval host-plant gardens shaped by TNBS surveys turned reclaimed wetland edges at Vellalore into an educational butterfly sanctuary.

press.title: Monsoon currents and the annual Tamil Nadu butterfly migration
press.summary: Feature on Tamil Nadu Danainae butterfly migration citing TNBS field monitoring across Yercaud, Salem, Coimbatore, and Western Ghats corridors.

press.title: Tamil Nadu witnesses below-par butterfly movement during rainfall deficit
press.summary: TNBS migration monitors documented a sharp drop in 2023 post-monsoon butterfly flights after severe rainfall deficits in Eastern Ghats breeding districts.

press.title: Butterfly Watching in Kalvarayan & Shervarayan Eastern Ghats Hills
press.summary: Aneesh Pandian documents 67 butterfly species at 700-800 m elevation in the Eastern Ghats including Large Oakblue, Lobed Beak, Baronet, and Southern Birdwing.

press.title: Snouts and Beaks: Evolution and Status of Libytheinae
press.summary: Review article by A. Pavendhan examining global beak butterflies and comparing Tamil Nadu residents Club Beak (Libythea myrrha) and Southern Beak (Libythea laius).

press.title: Amaidhi Solai: A Hidden Butterfly Hotspot in the Palani Hills
press.summary: Gopalakrishnan S reveals 59 species from two visits along an eastern Palani foothills stream near Kombai Dam including Nilgiri Tit, Lesser Gull, Yamfly, and Blue Oakleaf.

press.title: Thanthai Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary declaration cites Erode survey data
press.summary: Tamil Nadu notified 80,567 hectares in Erode Forest Division as the 18th state wildlife sanctuary citing 118 butterfly species recorded during the September 2020 TNBS-TNFD survey.

press.title: Six Years at Kannankurichi (Mookaneri) Lake, Salem: 104 Species
press.summary: Dr. M. Elavarasan chronicles 104 butterfly species across five families and 34 early-stage life cycles observed during regular walks at Kannankurichi Lake below Yercaud Hills.

press.title: 4th Coimbatore Forest Division Census Records 170 Butterfly Species
press.summary: Sixteen field teams from TNBS, CNS, WWF-India, and Tamil Nadu Forest Department recorded 170 butterfly species and 228 bird species across CFD in November 2022.

press.title: Two-day survey finds 175 butterfly species in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve
press.summary: Joint winter baseline survey by the Tamil Nadu Forest Department, TNBS, and WWF-India documented 175 species across core and buffer forest zones.

press.title: First-ever butterfly survey in Mudumalai Tiger Reserve records 175 species
press.summary: Inaugural structured butterfly census at MTR recorded highlights such as the Yellow Jack Sailer and Tamil Nadu's state butterfly, Tamil Yeoman.

press.title: 129 butterfly species recorded during two-day survey in Sirumalai Hills
press.summary: Dindigul Forest Division and TNBS volunteers recorded 129 species amid rain, including endemic and range-significant Eastern Ghats sightings.

press.title: 129 butterfly species traced at Sirumalai Hills in Tamil Nadu
press.summary: Documented the first Eastern Ghats record of the Plane butterfly alongside Palni Bushbrown, Large Guava Blue, Silver Royal, and Tamil Spotted Flat.

press.title: Sathyamangalam and Tamil Nadu: a home to rich and diverse butterfly populations
press.summary: Feature on Tamil Nadu's diverse Western and Eastern Ghats habitats and collaborative forest reserve surveys involving TNBS naturalists.

press.title: Black Rajah Status & Nadugani Tropical Genepool Butterfly Assessment
press.summary: Selvaraj Selvamurugan examines Charaxes solon ecology while A. Pavendhan reports baseline butterfly assessments from Gudalur Division and Vettaipereyampalayam in Erode.

press.title: Malabar Banded Swallowtail Sightings & Crimson Rose Migration to Sri Lanka
press.summary: A. Pavendhan highlights Papilio liomedon sightings in Tamil Nadu and Paulmathi Vinod documents coastal Crimson Rose (Pachliopta hector) movement toward Sri Lanka.

press.title: Five Years at Singanallur Wetland & Vandalur Tree Park Checklists
press.summary: Issue 19 documents Singanallur wetland butterfly trends, Salem Forest Division survey participation, and Vandalur Genetic Resources Tree Park observations by Monika Gandhi.

press.title: Coimbatore's Singanallur Lake is a cosy nesting ground for 104 butterfly species
press.summary: Multi-year wetland monitoring documented 104 butterfly species across five families thriving around Singanallur urban biodiversity zone.

press.title: First record of early immature stages of White Four-ring (Ypthima ceylonica) & new host plant
press.summary: TNBS members Hari Theivaprakasham, Hari Ramanasaran, and Appavu Pavendhan published the first full life-cycle description of Ypthima ceylonica in India and reported Cynodon dactylon as a new host plant.

press.title: Butterflies of Tamil Nadu booklet introduces 90 common species
press.summary: TNBS released a 24-page beginner booklet covering 90 Tamil Nadu butterflies, life cycles, migration, host gardening, and nine species named after Tamil Nadu.

press.title: Siruvani Hills identified as a butterfly super-hotspot
press.summary: Years of systematic field documentation by TNBS members established Siruvani Hills and Kovai Kutralam as a premier butterfly diversity hotspot.

press.title: Life Cycle of Common Banded Awl & Erode Forest Division Survey
press.summary: C.V. Nishanth documents the complete life cycle of Hasora chromus alongside A. Pavendhan summarizing the Erode Forest Division baseline survey.

press.title: The Butterfly Vision app allows instant identification of Western Ghats butterflies
press.summary: Profile of TNBS member Theivaprakasham Hari's AI identification platform launched for 300+ Western Ghats butterflies and later expanded to 923+ Indian taxa.

press.title: Kallar recognised as a butterfly hotspot with 200 species recorded
press.summary: Long-term TNBS study in the Mettupalayam forest range documented 200 species in Kallar, nearly two-thirds of Tamil Nadu's known butterfly richness.

press.title: Painted Lady Invasion into Tamil Nadu & IIT Madras Outburst
press.summary: A. Pavendhan analyzes widespread Vanessa cardui influxes across Tamil Nadu while Theivaprakasham Hari documents a seasonal butterfly emergence outbreak across IIT Madras.

press.title: Early Stages of Plains Blue Royal & AI for Butterfly Conservation
press.summary: Ramanasaran Hari documents Plains Blue Royal (Tajuria jehana) larval stages and Theivaprakasham Hari introduces AI-assisted butterfly conservation tools.

press.title: Tarucus balkanicus nigra: A Rare Find & Five-Year Coimbatore Wetlands Study
press.summary: Issue 5 presents Black-spotted Pierrot records in Tamil Nadu, a 5-year Coimbatore wetland study, and an updated Coimbatore District butterfly checklist.

activities.title: Pachamalai Hills Butterfly Survey
activities.summary: Conducted with Tiruchirappalli Forest Division across 7 reserve forests and eco-tourism zones, documenting 126 butterfly species across all 6 families, including the Schedule II Banded Royal, bringing Pachamalai's combined checklist to 149.
activities.photoAlt: TNBS survey team and Forest Department officials holding the Pachamalai Butterfly Survey banner in December 2024

activities.title: Mudumalai Tiger Reserve Monsoon Survey
activities.summary: Coordinated with Tamil Nadu Forest Department and WWF-India across 16 teams in Udhagai and Masinagudi divisions, recording 185+ butterfly species and observing thousands of migrating Common Grass Yellows.
activities.photoAlt: Participants, naturalists and Tamil Nadu Forest Department staff gathered at Theppakadu for the Mudumalai Monsoon Butterfly Survey in June 2024

activities.title: TNBS Government School Tamil Poster Project
activities.summary: Free Tamil butterfly awareness posters and educational booklets distributed across government schools in 13+ Tamil Nadu districts including Chennai, Salem, Krishnagiri, Tiruppur, Dharmapuri, Cuddalore, and The Nilgiris.
activities.photoAlt: Tamil butterfly awareness posters and booklets prepared on classroom desks for distribution to government school teachers

activities.title: Coimbatore Vizha Walk at Kovai Kutralam
activities.summary: Joint walk by TNBS and Coimbatore Nature Society introducing 20 newcomers to butterfly watching, recording 71+ butterfly species including Clipper, Indian Tawny Rajah, Tamil Yeoman, and Short-banded Sailer.

activities.title: City Nature Challenge, Coimbatore & Singanallur
activities.summary: TNBS led butterfly walks at Singanallur and joined Coimbatore conservation groups to help document 1,820+ taxa across urban wetlands and parks.
activities.photoAlt: TNBS core volunteers wearing official society field shirts during a Coimbatore biodiversity walk

activities.title: Coimbatore Forest Division Synchronised Survey
activities.summary: TNBS teamed up with the Tamil Nadu Forest Department, Coimbatore Nature Society, and WWF-India across wetland and terrestrial survey phases.
activities.photoAlt: Volunteers and Forest Department officials assembled outside TNFA Coimbatore for the synchronised biodiversity survey

activities.title: School Awareness Sessions & Kallar Walk
activities.summary: Led a Kovai Vizha butterfly walk at Kallar (56 species recorded) and addressed students and educators from Coimbatore and Pollachi districts on butterflies and host plants.
activities.photoAlt: TNBS President A. Pavendhan speaking to school children about blooms and butterflies during an educational session

activities.title: Tamil Nadu Danainae Migration Monitoring
activities.summary: Over a decade tracking pre-monsoon (April-May) and post-monsoon (September-November) flights of Blue Tigers, Dark Blue Tigers, and Crows between the Eastern and Western Ghats.

hotspots.label: Western Ghats Hotspots
hotspots.headline: High-diversity forests & biosphere corridors
hotspots.intro: Where moist evergreen valleys, bamboo slopes, and foothill streams shelter over 200 butterfly species including Western Ghats endemics.

cards.summary: Multi-year TNBS documentation established Kallar as a flagship hotspot holding nearly two-thirds of Tamil Nadu's butterfly checklist.
Two reserve-wide surveys across all 8 ranges with TNFD and WWF-India recorded 175 (Dec 2022) and 185 (June 2024) species.
Wet riparian forests near Coimbatore harbouring Tamil Yeoman, Clipper, Indian Tawny Rajah, and Malabar Rose.

hotspots.label: Eastern Ghats Surveys
hotspots.headline: Under-studied hills revealing key range records
hotspots.intro: Discontinuous hills like Pachamalai, Sirumalai, and Yercaud connect interior plains with monsoon breeding habitats.

cards.summary: Recorded all 6 butterfly families in Dec 2024, highlighted by healthy numbers of the Schedule II Banded Royal.
Joint Oct 2022 census added the first Eastern Ghats record of the Plane butterfly alongside Palni Bushbrown.
Heavy southwest monsoon rains over Yercaud and Salem hills trigger late-September butterfly swarms heading southwest.

hotspots.label: Urban Wetlands & Parks
hotspots.headline: Thriving urban biodiversity sanctuaries in Coimbatore
hotspots.intro: Systematic wetland checklists show how restoring native host plants and lake margins sustains over 100 resident species inside cities.

cards.summary: A 5-year TNBS study mapped over a hundred butterfly species along lake bunds, grasslands, and annual City Nature Challenge walks.
A year-long TNBS survey guided native host planting with KKPA, culminating in Coimbatore's first dedicated butterfly park in 2024.
Free Tamil educational posters and booklets help students spot urban garden butterflies and plant caterpillar hosts.

hotspots.label: Migration Corridors
hotspots.headline: Biannual butterfly flights tracked since 2013
hotspots.intro: TNBS monitors two seasonal directions driven by southwest and northeast monsoon winds between Tamil Nadu's hill ranges.

cards.summary: Tigers and Crows leave Pollachi and Coimbatore hills toward Tiruppur, Erode, and Sathyamangalam ahead of southwest rains.
Millions of Dark Blue Tigers (95% share with Blue Tigers) and Crows stream from Yercaud/Salem over Coimbatore toward Nilgiris and Anamalais.
A rare large-scale movement of Common Grass Yellows recorded alongside tiger and crow migrants during the MTR monsoon count.

about.registration: Reg. No. 259/2018 (Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975)
about.address: 8, AKG Nagar, 3rd Street, Uppilipalayam, Coimbatore - 641015, Tamil Nadu, India
about.facebookGroup: Tamilnadu Butterflies Facebook group (founded 02 Oct 2014; 2,340+ members across all 38 districts of Tamil Nadu & Puducherry)
leadership: A. Pavendhan: President & Chief Editor, Pattampoochi

Core & Editorial Team: Bala Krishnan, Gopal Krishnan, C.V. Nishanth, K. Sadheeskumar, K. Sravan Kumar, H. Theivaprakasham, Vishwa Nathan, H. Ramanasaran, Dr. M. Elavarasan, and regional volunteers across Tamil Nadu
milestones: Base checklist compilation begins; Tamilnadu Butterflies Facebook group launched (02 Oct 2014) to gather verified sightings across districts.
Tamil Nadu Butterfly Checklist v1 prepared (323 species; 271 validated initially) and quarterly e-magazine Pattampoochi launched in Q1 2017.
Registered as The Nature and Butterfly Society (259/2018); state butterfly discussions and steady expansion of verified checklist records to 325 species.
Siruvani Hills documented as a butterfly super-hotspot; joint Tamil Nadu Forest Department surveys across Mudumalai, Sathyamangalam, Coimbatore, Erode, Salem, and Sirumalai.
Tamil Nadu butterfly checklist reaches 329 species across 6 families (325 validated in TN), government school Tamil posters reach 13+ districts, and Butterfly Vision AI tops 923+ species.
